summary.goal: Learn optimal model selection using Thompson sampling multi-armed bandit with stability controls

acceptance_criteria.description: selectModel checks hard rules first (from config)
Random model selected with probability = exploration_rate (during burn-in)
Thompson sampling samples from Beta(α,β) for each model
Model with highest sampled value is selected (after passing stability checks)
recordOutcome updates Beta distribution (α++ on success, β++ on failure)
New model/taskType/complexity starts with Beta(1,1) prior
sampleBeta uses Gamma distribution sampling trick
MIN_SAMPLES (30) required per arm before exploitation (use round-robin during burn-in)
Hysteresis: new model must have ≥15% higher probability than current to switch
